verses.text: Ayik toxo ix cham winhaj rey Acab, ix yik'anel sb'a chonhab' Moab t'a yalanh smandar chonhab' Israel.

Ay jun k'u ix kot sutnaj winhaj Ocozías yuninal winhaj Acab chi' t'a spanhanil yib'anh spat t'a Samaria. Te niwan ix aj winh slajwi, yuj chi' ix schekb'at heb' schekab' winh yik b'at sk'anb'ej yab' heb' t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal heb' aj Ecrón, tato olto b'oxok winh.

Palta ha jun yángel Jehová ix halan t'a winhaj Elías aj Tisbe icha tik: Ixik, b'at cha heb' schekab' winhaj Ocozías sreyal Samaria, tzalan t'a heb' icha tik: ¿Tom malaj Dios t'a ko chonhab' ha honh israel honh tik, yuj chi' hato t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal Ecrón sb'at he k'anb'ej heyab'i? xa chi t'a heb'.

Tzalanpaxi to ha hin Jehová hin swal t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: Manhxo ol hach k'e wa'an, palta ol hach chamxonhej, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi yángel Jehová chi' t'a winhaj Elías chi'. Ix b'at winhaj Elías chi', ix sk'anab'ajan winh icha tas ix alji chi' t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix meltzaj heb' schekab' winh rey chi', ix k'ochxi heb' t'a yichanh winh, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb': --¿Tas yuj ix hex meltzaj t'a elanhchamel? xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix tak'wi heb': --Mamin rey, ay jun winh winak ix ko cha t'a yol b'e. Ha winh ix halan t'ayonh icha tik: Meltzajanhek t'a winh ix hex chekankot chi', tzeyalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: ¿Tom malaj Dios t'a Israel tik, yuj chi' hato t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal Ecrón tza chekb'at ab'chajok? Yuj wal jun tas ix ha na' tik, manhxo ol hach k'e wa'an, ol hach chamxonhej, xchi Jehová, xe chi, xchi jun winh chi' t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --¿Chajtil yilji jun winh ix halan chi' t'ayex? xchi winh.

--Mamin rey, ha jun winh chi' ayoch jun pichul ay xi'il yuj winh, aypaxoch jun tzek'ul tz'u'um t'a snanhal winh, xchi heb' t'a winh. --Ha jun winh chi', haton winhaj Elías aj Tisbe, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekanb'at jun winh capitán winh rey chi' yet' 50 heb' winh soldado yik b'at ik'jokkot winhaj Elías chi'. Haxo yik ix k'och heb' t'a winh, k'ojanem winh t'a jun tzalan. Ix yalan winh capitán chi' t'a winh: --Hach schekab' Dios, ha winh rey ix alankoti to tzach emta, xchi winh capitán chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Tato schekab' hin Dios, kotokab' k'ak' t'a satcha'anh tzach tz'ab'at yet' 50 heb' winh ha soldado chi', xchi winh. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix emta k'ak', ix tz'ab'at heb' winh smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekanxib'at junxo winh capitán winh rey chi' yet' 50-xo heb' winh soldado, ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Elías chi': --Hach schekab' Dios, emanhkot t'a elanhchamel yal winh rey, xchi winh capitán chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Elías chi': --Tato schekab' hin Dios, kotokab' k'ak' t'a satcha'anh tzach tz'ab'at yet' 50 heb' winh ha soldado chi', xchi winh. T'a wal jun rato chi' ix emta k'ak' t'a satcha'anh, ix tz'ab'at heb' winh smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekanxib'at junxo winh capitán winh rey chi' yet' 50-xo heb' winh soldado t'a yoxelal. Palta ha jun winh capitán chi', ix k'ek'och winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Elías chi', ix em kuman winh t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan winh: --Mamin schekab' Dios, ak' wal niwank'olal t'a wib'anh yet' 50 heb' winh soldado ha chekab' tik.

Yujto ha juntzanh heb' winh capitán yet' soldado, heb' winh ix b'ab'laj ja t'ayach, ix tz'ab'at heb' winh yuj k'ak' ix kot t'a satcha'anh. Ha hin tik tzin tewi t'ayach to tzonh ak' niwank'olal yik max honh chami, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan yángel Jehová chi' t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Ixik yet' winh, manh hach xiwok, xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix emta winhaj Elías chi', ix b'at winh yet' winh capitán chi', ix b'at winh yil winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winh rey chi': --Icha wal tik yalan Jehová: Yujto ix ha chekb'at heb' ha chekab' t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal Ecrón, yik b'at ha k'anb'ej ha b'a, ichato malaj Dios t'a Israel tik b'aj syal tza k'anb'ej ab'i, yuj chi' manhxo ol hach k'e wa'an, palta to ol hach chamxonhej, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Elías chi'.

Icha chi' ix aji, ix cham winh rey chi', icha tas ix schek Jehová yal winhaj Elías chi'. Yujto malaj junok yuninal winhaj Ocozías chi', yuj chi' ha jun winh yuktak winh skuchan Joram, ha winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok, haton yik schab'ilxo ab'il yoch junxo winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Josafat reyal t'a Judá.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Ocozías yet' juntzanhxo tas ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
